title: Manatee County Commission, District 1
what_it_does: County commissioners set the county budget and property-tax (millage) rate, adopt land-use and zoning rules, and oversee county services such as roads, parks, libraries, fire/EMS and utilities.
verified_ballot_note: November lineup per Suncoast News Network and Pulse of Manatee.

candidates.name: Elizabeth "Liz" Arnold
candidates.occupation: Retired utility finance director (Florida Power Corporation); Parrish
candidates.primary_result: First in Aug 18 GOP primary with 27.96% (3,401)

taxes.summary: Would reduce taxes where possible, saying the county should not be so flush with reserves that it takes money from residents, and would stop wasteful spending.
taxes.quote: we shouldn't be so flush with reserves that we are taking money away from our residents

candidates.name: Sari Lindroos-Valimaki
candidates.background: Democrat Sari Lindroos-Valimaki of Palmetto is a native of Finland and a naturalized U.S. citizen with an MBA and a career in information technology, cybersecurity and infrastructure. She ran for the at-large District 7 commission seat in 2024 and says the 2021 Piney Point wastewater emergency near her neighborhood spurred that run. In 2026 she faces Republican Elizabeth 'Liz' Arnold and a write-in candidate in District 1.

taxes.summary: Supports a new dedicated stormwater utility fee based on impervious surface, and says the county must plan for lost revenue if the property-tax amendment passes.
taxes.quote: I support a dedicated stormwater utility fee structured equitably around impervious surface

sources.title: Manatee Chamber of Commerce candidate questionnaire - Sari Lindroos-Valimaki

housing.summary: In a 2024 Manatee Chamber of Commerce questionnaire she called for upzoning in strategic locations, inclusionary zoning that mandates a share of affordable units in new developments, fast-track approvals, community land trusts on county land, tax abatements and low-interest loans for affordable housing developers, density bonuses and reduced impact fees for affordable projects.
housing.quote: Inclusionary Zoning: Mandate that a percentage of new residential developments be designated for affordable housing to ensure a balanced housing market.

environment.summary: In 2024 she called the commission's easing of wetland buffer protections its biggest mistake and said she would push to reinstate and strengthen them, citing biodiversity and climate resilience. At a June 2026 Tiger Bay debate she said she is 'passionate against Mosaic and phosphates' and stressed protecting farmland.
environment.quote: As a commissioner, I would advocate for reinstating and strengthening wetland protections.
